MediaPipe Hand Landmarker (float16, version 1)
Provider: Google / MediaPipe
Used by the separate ClashMIT melee test page.

https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task

The model detects hand landmarks and handedness. It does not identify a person.
Coordinates are camera-relative; this test does not measure real-world contact.
